english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making a process or its progress happen faster.
Use this when something is made to happen at a higher rate, rather than describing how fast it is already going.
Use this specifically when speeding up the rate or progress of an activity or process rather than simply rushing.

examples.english: Can you expedite the approval process for this document?
examples.traditional: 你幫我加快吓呢份文件嘅審批流程，得唔得？

examples.english: We need to speed up production so we can finish on time.
examples.traditional: 我哋要加快生產，先趕得切。
